DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写真の地図に出ている場所で見つけたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you find it at the place shown on the map in the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 実際は隣の通りです。電話の表示がずれているようなので、地図だけで場所を決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 画像の位置表示と実際の発見場所のずれを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Actually, it was on the next street. The phone's location display seems off, so please don't determine the location from the map alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the discrepancy between the image's location display and the actual discovery site. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つけた場所を、目印で説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you describe where you found it using landmarks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 薬局の正面の塀です。写真の奥に薬局の青い看板が写っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現場の目印と写っている物で場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the wall opposite the pharmacy. The pharmacy's blue sign appears in the background of the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the location using landmarks and objects visible in the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。写真はいつ撮りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. When did you take the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の八時です。壊された時刻ではなく、私が見つけて撮った時刻です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影時刻を発生時刻と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: At eight today. That is when I found it and took the photo, not when it was damaged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the time of photography from the time of the incident. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。発見時刻と損傷が起きた時刻を分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will record the discovery time separately from when the damage occurred.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。位置を直した画像だけにせず、元の写真と正しい場所の説明を両方見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元画像を残し正しい場所の説明を添える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Rather than showing only an image with the location corrected, I will show both the original photo and an explanation of the correct location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the original image and add an explanation of the correct location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。写真の扱いは担当者が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The person in charge will explain how the photos will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。実際の目印と撮影時刻を伝え、壊した人や発生時刻は分からないと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認できる場所と時刻だけを伝え不明点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will give the actual landmarks and photo time, and explain that I don't know who damaged it or when it happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give only the location and time you can confirm, and identify what is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。元の写真と位置の説明を担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will pass the original photo and location explanation to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: それぞれの小包の中身を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what is inside each parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらは服、もう一つは本です。あ、箱を動かしたので逆かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱移動で中身の説明が逆かもしれないと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This one has clothes and the other has books. Oh, I moved the boxes, so I may have them reversed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that moving the boxes may have reversed your description of their contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分からないまま品名を決めず、宛名と中身を対応させましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's match the addresses to the contents rather than decide on item descriptions while unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 兄宛てには本、弟宛てには服です。箱の色で覚えたので、今は見分けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先ごとの意図した内容と識別不能を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The books are for my older brother, and the clothes are for my younger brother. I remembered them by box color, so I can't distinguish them now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the intended contents for each recipient and that you cannot identify the boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要ならご自身で中身を確認してから、梱包し直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If necessary, you can check the contents yourself and then repack them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認します。兄の名前の箱に服があれば、品名だけ直すのでなく、送る中身も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 品名だけでなく中身と送り先の一致を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check. If the box with my older brother's name contains clothes, I will review what I am sending as well, rather than just correct the item description.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check that the contents match the recipient, not just the item description. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。宛名と意図した品物が一致するようご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please make sure the address and intended items match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認したら、兄の箱が本でした。外に番号を付け、宛名と中身をメモで対応させます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実物確認後に番号とメモで対応付ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked, and my older brother's box contained books. I will number the outside and use a note to match each address to its contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After checking the actual items, link them using numbers and a note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。確認後の品名で発送の受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will proceed with accepting the parcels using the verified item descriptions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。二つの宛名と品名を一つずつ読み上げて、入れ替わっていないか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つを一件ずつ照合して発送を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will read each of the two addresses and item descriptions aloud, one at a time, to check that they haven't been switched.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the two parcels individually and request shipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。兄宛ての本と、弟宛ての服の順に確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the books for your older brother first, then the clothes for your younger brother.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先の控えと記入した番号を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will check your copy of the transfer destination and the number you entered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 元の番号はゼロからですが、数字として同じだと思ってゼロを省きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座番号の先頭ゼロを省いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The original number starts with zero, but I omitted it because I thought it was numerically the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you omitted the account number's leading zero. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座情報の表記は、自己判断で省略せず確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Account information must be checked without abbreviating its notation at your own discretion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 計算する数ではなく、相手を示す番号なんですね。元の記載に合わせる方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 計算値と識別番号を区別し正しい表記を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is an identifier for the recipient, not a number for calculation. Please tell me how to match the original notation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish a numerical value from an identifier and check the correct notation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 振込先の銀行や口座種別も含めて担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the destination bank and account type as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。このメッセージが相手からの元情報です。別のメモで短くした番号ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 加工した控えでなく相手の元情報を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. This message is the original information from the recipient, not the shortened number in a separate note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present the recipient's original information rather than an altered copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。元情報と申込内容を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We will compare the original information with the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号を正しく写しただけで、受取人名の確認まで終わるとは思っていません。名前も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号だけでなく受取人名も確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't assume that copying the number correctly also completes the recipient-name check. I would like to check the name too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the recipient's name as well as the number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、必要な情報を全て確認してから手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will explain the procedure after checking all necessary information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。先頭を含む番号と受取人の情報を確かめ、合ってから振込を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全情報が一致してから振込を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will check the entire number, including its beginning, and the recipient's information, and decide on the transfer after they match.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on the transfer only after all information matches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号の表記を含め、振込先確認の担当者へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will direct you to the person who checks transfer destinations, including the number's notation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷たいお菓子には、この袋を一緒に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: We put this packet in with the chilled sweets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この透明な袋も食べる物ですか。子どもがゼリーだと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 添えられた袋が食品か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this transparent packet something to eat too? My child thinks it is jelly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the accompanying packet is food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは保冷剤で、食品ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is an ice pack, not food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ開けていません。お菓子の袋に入っていても、食べ物とは限らないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封を伝え同梱と食用を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't opened it yet. Even something inside the sweets bag isn't necessarily food, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is unopened and distinguish being packaged together from being edible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。袋の表示も確認し、子どもが食品と間違えないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please check the packet's label too and ensure your child does not mistake it for food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。お菓子と区別して、子どもが勝手に開けないよう私が持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもが開けないよう本人が管理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will keep it separate from the sweets and hold it myself so my child cannot open it without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Take charge of the packet yourself so the child cannot open it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身はお菓子へかけたり、袋を破って使ったりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not pour its contents onto the sweets or tear the packet open to use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この保冷剤をどう置いて使うか、商品の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 破らず配置などの使い方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. I would like to hear the product instructions on where to put this ice pack and how to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to position and use it without tearing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が持ち帰り時の扱いをご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to handle it on the way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。食品と保冷剤を分けて確認し、使い方を聞いてから袋にしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食品と保冷剤を区別し説明後にしまう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will distinguish the food from the ice pack, check both, and put them in the bag after hearing how to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the food and ice pack and pack them after the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの担当者から保冷剤の扱いをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. This staff member will explain how to handle the ice pack.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 机の貸し出しについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about borrowing tables?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。集会室を予約したので、その机を外の芝生へ運んでピクニックに使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 室内予約の机を屋外へ使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I reserved the meeting room. Can I carry its tables outside onto the lawn for a picnic?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether tables from the reserved room can be used outdoors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 室内設備の利用と、屋外への持ち出しは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Using indoor equipment and taking it outdoors are separate matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 部屋を借りれば家具も自由に使えると思いました。まだ机は動かしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 設備をまだ動かしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought renting the room meant I could use the furniture freely. I haven't moved the tables yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not moved the equipment yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では室内の机を屋外へ出せません。屋外用の貸し出しがあるかは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation, the indoor tables cannot be taken outside. We will separately check whether outdoor tables are available to borrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。室内の予約は会合で使うので残し、屋外用の机だけ追加で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 室内予約を残し屋外用だけを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will keep the indoor reservation for our meeting and would like to ask only about adding outdoor tables.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the room reservation and ask only about outdoor tables. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。芝生のどこで使う予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Where on the lawn do you plan to use them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板の近くです。ただ、通路をふさぐ位置になるなら、別の場所を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望場所を示し通路を妨げるなら変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Near the information board. But if that would block the path, I will choose somewhere else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your preferred location and offer to change it if it obstructs the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用場所と貸し出し条件を担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the location and borrowing conditions with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。室内机はそのままにし、屋外設備と場所が認められてから準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 屋外設備と場所の確認後に準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will leave the indoor tables where they are and prepare after the outdoor equipment and location are approved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare only after the outdoor equipment and location are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。室内予約は維持し、屋外用設備の相談を担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will retain your room reservation and pass your outdoor-equipment request to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだお金を入れていませんが、受け口に硬貨があります。前の人の物かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金前から硬貨が残ると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't put any money in yet, but there are coins in the tray. They may belong to the previous person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that coins were already there before you inserted money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのままにして係員へお知らせください。ご自分のお金と混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please leave them there and notify an attendant. Do not mix them with your own money.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。あとで自分のお釣りだと思わないよう、先に伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の釣銭と混同しないため先に伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I told you first so I wouldn't later mistake them for my own change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you reported them first to avoid confusing them with your own change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係員が確認する間、別の券売機をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: While an attendant checks, we can show you another ticket machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。残った硬貨を支払いに使わず、自分の千円で券を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残存硬貨を使わず別機で自分の現金を使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will buy my ticket with my own thousand yen without using the leftover coins as payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use your own cash at another machine without using the remaining coins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの券売機でどうぞ。購入金額も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use this machine. Check the purchase amount too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四百円の券なので、お釣りは六百円ですね。今度は自分が入れた額と表示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払額と購入額から自分の釣銭を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The ticket is four hundred yen, so my change will be six hundred yen. This time I will check the amount I inserted and the display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check your own change against the payment and purchase amounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。券と硬貨を受け取ってからご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check after collecting your ticket and coins.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 券と六百円を確認しました。最初の硬貨は係員に任せ、そのまま帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回の券と釣銭を受け取り残存硬貨は係員に任せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the ticket and six hundred yen. I will leave the original coins to the attendant and go now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Collect this ticket and change, leaving the earlier coins to the attendant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。残っていた硬貨は係員が確認します。お知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. An attendant will check the coins that were left. Thank you for telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所のどの部分を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of your address would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 学校の紙では建物名を略しています。こちらの用紙も同じ略し方でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学校と行政用紙の建物名表記を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The building name is abbreviated on the school form. Can I use the same abbreviation on this form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the building-name notation on school and administrative forms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正式な住所が分かる資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a document showing your official address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書があります。部屋番号は同じで、建物名だけが学校の紙と違う表記です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正式資料を示し部屋番号は同じと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my contract. The room number is the same; only the building name is written differently from the school form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show an official document and say that the room number is the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の住居へ移ったわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you have not moved to a different residence?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、引っ越していません。略称と正式名の違いとして確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居ではなく略称の違いだと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right, I haven't moved. Please check it as a difference between an abbreviated and official name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clarify that this is a name-abbreviation difference, not a move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が必要な表記を案内します。用紙はまだ記入前ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain the required notation. Have you started filling in the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前だけ書きました。住所を二種類重ねて書かず、確認した表記で一つだけ記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認前に住所を重ね書きしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have written only my name. I will not write two address versions over each other; I will enter just one after checking the notation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not overwrite the address before checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 学校に出す情報も直すなら、学校へ別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you also want to correct the information submitted to the school, please check with the school separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。住民課の用紙と学校の記録を別々に確認し、同じ家だと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行政と学校それぞれで必要表記を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will check the residents' affairs form and the school records separately and explain that they refer to the same home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the required notation separately with the administration and school. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。契約書と学校の紙を持って、表記の相談として担当窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take your contract and school form to the appropriate counter for a discussion of address notation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 健診の用紙はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have your health-check form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の用紙があります。検査が終わってから書いてもらえばよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社用紙を検査後に渡す予定だったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the company form. I thought I could have it filled in after the tests were finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you planned to hand over the company form after the tests. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 指定の検査項目がある場合、先に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: If there are specified test items, we need to check them beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では今見せます。病院の通常の健診と、会社の項目が同じか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用紙を提示し予約検査との一致が不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will show it now. I don't know whether the hospital's usual checkup includes the same items as my company's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the form and explain that you don't know whether it matches the booked tests. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者が項目と予約内容を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will compare the items with your appointment details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。用紙があるだけで、全部の検査を今日受けられるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全項目の当日実施を前提にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I won't assume that having the form means I can have every test today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume all items can be performed today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 費用や所要時間も、確認した内容に沿ってご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the cost and time required based on what we confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。追加の項目が必要なら、費用と時間を聞いてから進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加項目の費用と時間を事前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If additional items are needed, I would like to hear their cost and duration before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the cost and duration of additional items beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が済むまで、用紙は担当者がお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will keep the form until the check is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。先に会社指定の項目を照合し、内容と費用を理解してから健診を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 項目と費用の説明後に健診を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will have the company-specified items checked first and undergo the checkup after understanding the contents and cost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed with the checkup after the items and costs are explained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。指定用紙と予約内容の確認を、健診担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will pass the specified form and appointment details to the health-check staff for verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵を紛失したというご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a lost key?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくしていません。この鍵を持っていますが、鍵穴で回らず、開けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失でなく鍵が回らないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't lost it. I have this key, but it won't turn in the lock, so I can't unlock it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the issue: the key will not turn; it is not lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鍵の不具合についてですね。ご自身の自転車ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it is a problem with the key. Is it your own bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、私のです。鍵が回らないから盗まれたと決めたわけでもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人所有で盗難を断定していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it's mine. I haven't concluded that it was stolen just because the key won't turn, either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you own it and are not asserting theft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 故障の修理は販売店などへの相談になります。今、自転車はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: For repairs, you will need to consult the retailer or a similar service. Where is the bicycle now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅の駐輪場です。移動できず利用時間が延びるので、管理者へ先に知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 動かせない自転車の保管場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: In the station bicycle parking area. Since I cannot move it and my parking time will increase, I want to notify the manager first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain where the immovable bicycle is parked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 所有と駐輪場所が分かる物を用意し、適切な相談先をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please prepare documents showing ownership and the parking location, and check the appropriate contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 登録の控えがあります。鍵を持つことだけで所有確認が済むと思わず、控えも持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所有資料を用意し鍵所持だけで判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my registration copy. I won't assume holding the key is enough to verify ownership; I will bring that copy too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare ownership documents without relying solely on possession of the key. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。修理のために切断する場合の扱いも、管理者や修理先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Also check with the manager or repair service about the procedure if the lock must be cut for repairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。紛失届ではなく不具合の相談として、所有資料と場所を示して修理先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紛失届と修理相談を分け適切な相手へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will consult about a malfunction rather than file a lost-key report, showing the ownership documents and location to the repair service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish a lost-key report from a repair consultation and contact the appropriate party. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらでは相談先の案内を行います。鍵と控えはお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will explain whom to contact here. Please take your key and registration copy with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒に送り先の住所がありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: There is no destination address on the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手紙の中に書いてあります。中を読めば住所が分かると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本文の住所を読んで配達できると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is written inside the letter. I thought you could find the address by reading it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought delivery could use the address read from the letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達の宛先は、封筒の外に分かる形で必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The delivery address must be clearly visible on the outside of the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本文を読んで届ける方法ではないんですね。受取人からの住所を外にも書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒外に宛先を記すと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So delivery doesn't work by reading the letter's contents. I will write the recipient's address on the outside too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the destination must be written outside the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お願いします。手紙に書いた住所は、今回の送り先で間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. Is the address in the letter definitely the destination for this mailing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本文には前に住んだ所の話もあります。受取人の最新の連絡にある住所を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本文に旧住所もあることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The letter also talks about a place where they used to live. I will use the address in the recipient's latest message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the letter also contains an old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 複数の住所があるなら、正式な送り先を先に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If there are several addresses, let's confirm the proper destination first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。本文から抜き出さず、本人に確認した住所だけを封筒へ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取人確認済みの現住所だけを記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't extract an address from the letter; I will write only the address confirmed with the recipient on the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Enter only the current address confirmed with the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き終えたら窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring it to the counter when you finish writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。外の宛名と受取人名を確認し、手紙を封してから発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒の宛名と中身を整えてから発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will check the address and recipient's name on the outside, seal the letter, and then mail it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the envelope's address and contents before requesting shipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。宛名の準備後に発送をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will explain mailing after you have prepared the address.
